prompt: Photorealistic close-up photo of the lower-left part of a midnight MacBook Air keyboard. The keys must look exactly like the first reference photo: the same dark matte keycaps, the same Apple San Francisco font, the same small lowercase labels. The key layout must match the second reference: bottom row from left is fn with a globe, control with ⌃, option with ⌥, command with ⌘, then the long space bar; above it the wide shift key with ⇧, then Z X C V. A person's left hand rests on the keys: the little finger presses the left shift key and the thumb presses the left command key, while the right thumb enters from the right edge and presses the space bar. Exactly those three keys (left shift, left command, space bar) glow with a soft violet light from underneath, like the highlighted keys in the second reference; all other keys stay unlit. Low three-quarter angle, soft window light, very shallow depth of field, Apple product film look. No other text.
